name: Dizzy

v1.prompt: The cat stands facing right, dizzy and wobbly: the head sways in slow small circles, eyes are spirals, legs a little unsteady, tail droops; three small stars circle above its head. Paws stay in place. Seamless loop: the last frame matches the first.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: weak: flat line-art style, a different tail shape and grey legs; stars read. Optional per A08
